data.title: League One predictions: All 12 matchday 14 games
data.content:
## Mansfield Town vs Notts County - Saturday October 31 (3pm)

### Key Stats

 Mansfield Town are unbeaten in six (W3 D3) in the league
 County are winless in seven of their last eight in the league
 The Stags have won 31 corners in their last four games; over 5.5 in each

### Team news

Mansfield Town could be minus midfielder Liam Thompson after he limped out of the 4-1 win at Blackpool with a calf injury. Baily Cargill, Lucas Akins and star striker David McGoldrick are out. [...] Skipper Matt Palmer remains crocked though a new-look midfield of Rory Finneran and Scott Robertson has done well. Lewis Macari, Matty Platt and Dean Campbell are out.

### Need to know

Mansfield have won their last six at home to derby rivals County, though Notts make the short trip on the back of a pair of fine results against Sheff Wed (2-0) and Stockport (1-1).

Score prediction

 Mansfield Town 2-1 Notts County (27/5 with LiveScore Bet) [...] ## Stockport vs AFC Wimbledon - Saturday October 31 (3pm)

### Key Stats

 Stockport's Kyle Wootton is the division's joint top scorer with nine goals
 AFC Wimbledon average a league-low 2.5 shots on target per game
 The Dons are without a win in eight in all comps (L5 D3)

### Team news

Stockport's Adama Sidibeh, their goalscoring hero in the 1-1 draw at Notts County on Saturday, could need surgery on a hamstring tear.

data.title: Dibley-Dias to miss County's game against Chesterfield - Yahoo Sports
data.content:
Advertisement

County's top goal scorer Shaquille Gwengwe will also miss Friday's fixture, as he completes a three-match suspension for kicking out at an opponent during Newport's draw with York City.

Despite their injury worries continuing to mount, Mullins insists his side are in a "good place" ahead of Chesterfield's visit.

"We're obviously disappointed to be missing a few players, but it creates an opportunity for someone else to come in and make an impact," said Mullins. [...] "Dibley-Dias has had a scan, and we're waiting to see the results of that, so he won't be ready for the weekend," Mullins said.

"Yahya has been back out training, so we'll have to see how he comes through and where he's at."

Both players join a growing list of injuries at the club that includes Christian Doidge, Tanatswa Nyakhuwa and the influential Matty Jacob.

Mullins' men head into the game after suffering a 1-0 loss away at Cheltenham Town on Saturday, their first league defeat in eight games.

Winger Yahya Bamba and midfielder Dibley-Dias were both forced off at the EV Charger Points Stadium, adding to County's injury crisis.
